main_text.p: bamina[?] offundunt: faciētes abscondītè, quod turpe est etiam dicere, & captiuas ducētes mulierculas oneratas peccatis, quæ ducuntur variis defideriis: semper discentes, & nunquam ad scientiam veritatis peruenientes. In 57. ca-put.
De his verè dicitur, Deuorant populum meum velut escam panis, & quós Christus nótat deuorantes domos viduarum. In 3. caput Ieremiæ.

Eorum cogitatio est ut calumnias struant, & sanctos viros accusatione prǽueniant, nec cogitant quòd illi veritatem loquantur, & quòd isti struant mendacia: iactant enim in sacerdotibus, & in sapientibus, & in pseudoprophetis suis, legem & consilium Dei, & eloquium permanere. In 18. caput.

Epistolas plenas mendaciorum, & fraudulé-tiæ, atque periurii, in orbem dirigunt, ut & aures polluant audientium, & existimatione sim-plicium lædant. Non enim eis sufficit iniquitatem propriam deuorare, & proximos lædere: sed quos semel oderunt, per vniuersum orbem infamare conantur, & vbiq; seminare blasphemias. In 23. caput.
Quia solent semper prospera polliceri, & sæclorum[?] regna peccatoribus pandere, ut dicat:

page.notes: Top line: "bamina" is uncertain (first letter may be l). Hyphenated "fraudulé-" and "sim-" are line-end breaks as printed. "sæclorum" is a smudged word, read with [?]. The page number is printed at top right. The running head is "CENTVRIA III." with the number as printed. Italic citations are kept in the text where they stand. Page is slightly stained with show-through, which is not transcribed.
